name: Kosumi Yuu
source:
Takuma's friend with whom he has a lot of things in common. They have been sharing a rotten relationship since high school, they both are classmate at the university, same circle of friends, and even have the same part-time job. Despite that, rather than being lovers, they prefer to be just friends who are constantly fighting. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20160415123521/http://www.eants.co.jp/game/question/index.html]official DVDPG version homepage at Eants[/url].]
